id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

datasetId.description:
The id of the {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun} to use as
the dataset of the model.

modelTemplateId.description: The id of the {@link ModelTemplate} to use.

hyperparameterOverrides.description:
The values used to override the hyperparameters of the pipeline outputted by the model template.
Key is hyperparam field name.

project.description: The project that is selected for the model configuration.

hyperparameterData.description:
Contains hyperparameter data for the current model template selected.
Format is determined by {@link ModelTemplate#getHyperparams}

hyperparameterDataModelTemplateId.description: The #modelTemplateId for which the hyperparameterData has been populated for.

editableHyperparameters.description:
Determines if hyperparameters of `Reliability.ModelConfigHyperparameters` should be editable.
If true, a row action should be shown allowing editing. If false, this row action is not visible.

markdownPathToRender.description: Path of markdown file to render within model template selection grid side panel

currentHyperparameter.description: Stores information about the current hyperparameter that is being edited in the hyperparam grid edit modal.

currentSidePanelTemplateName.description: Stores the name of the current template being displayed in the side panel of the ModelTemplate selection step.

stepButtonSettings.description: Map of step id to button status that controls the status and hover message of the continue button.

redirectTo.description: Stores the url of the page user originally intended to navigate to when exiting asset's Model Configuration workflow.

isCreateTrainedModelBeingCalled.description: Indicates if the call to create the trained model is being executed.

experimentModelStatus.description: Boolean field that indicates if the experiment model is completed.

baseModelIdForExperiment.description:
{@link ReliabilityMlModel} used as a base during the experiment model creation.

This field is used to populate the hyperparameters of the experiment model. ({ModelHyperparametersPopulateEpic})
if not populated, the id will be retrieved from {@link UiSdlPageParam} `configId`.

isDateRangeTooLong.description:
This field is used to indicate if the date range for the latest model experiment preview is more than 2 years.
By default, it is set to `false`. If the date range exceeds 2 years time period, it is set to `true`.

isPollingExperimentStatus.description:
Indicates whether the polling process for the experiment model status is currently active.
This flag is used to prevent multiple concurrent polling streams from being initiated. It should be set to `true`
when polling for the experiment status begins (e.g., when the user navigates to or refreshes the experiment status page),
and set to `false` when polling ends (e.g., when the user navigates away, the experiment status reaches a terminal state,
or polling is otherwise canceled).

editingModelExperimentPreview.description: This field indicates if the user is currently editing the experimental model preview.

originalTrainingValidationPeriods.description: Stores the original model training and validation period for the given modelId.

disableDataPrepSaveContinueButton.description:
Boolean flag indicating whether the save and continue button should be disabled in dataset preparation.
If the date range mask is out of training window, this is set to true and the user cannot proceed.

title: Application state for the model configuration workflow.
name: ModelConfigApplicationState
